description: This file provides functions to parse markdown content, extract tables, code blocks, and links, and convert them into LINE Flex Message format for display. It also includes a main processing function to handle markdown content and generate appropriate Flex Messages.

methods.name: extractMarkdownTables
methods.description: Extracts markdown tables from text and returns the tables along with the text without tables.

methods.name: convertTableToFlexBubble
methods.description: Converts a MarkdownTable object into a LINE Flex Message bubble.

methods.name: extractCodeBlocks
methods.description: Extracts code blocks from markdown text and returns them along with the text without code blocks.

methods.name: convertCodeBlockToFlexBubble
methods.description: Converts a CodeBlock object into a LINE Flex Message bubble.

methods.name: extractLinks
methods.description: Extracts markdown links from text and returns the links and text with links replaced.

methods.name: convertLinksToFlexBubble
methods.description: Creates a Flex Message bubble with tappable link buttons from extracted links.

methods.name: processLineMessage
methods.description: Main function to process markdown text, extract tables, code blocks, links, and produce processed text with associated Flex Messages.

methods.name: hasMarkdownToConvert
methods.description: Checks if the input text contains markdown that needs conversion.
